name: Bracelet Space
original_name: 手镯空间：医妃天降引太子破戒
overview:
Jiang Yue, a modern battlefield doctor, transmigrated into the past and became the second daughter of a noble family. However, the original host had been killed by her sister and her fiancé, whom she had been engaged to since she was a child, and they faked her death by tossing her off a cliff. Little did they know that Jiang Yue fell into the bath of Prince Chu Ling Xiao.

Jiang Yue took the initiative to relieve Chu Ling Xiao's cold poison. She thought it was to cure the disease and save people, but she didn't expect that the legendary abstinence prince, who was not close to women, pestered her, spoiled her and loved her like his life.

(Source: Chinese = Douban || Translation = MyDramaList)

~~ Adapted from the web novel "Chuan Yue Hou, Wo Cheng Le Leng Mian Sha Shen De Zhang Xin Bao" (穿越后，我成了冷面煞神的掌心宝) by Qu Li Yao (曲梨瑶).
